zh: 一个拿来试想法的地方
en: A place for trying out ideas

zh: 策略实验室只做一件事：你出一个想法，它告诉你这个想法到底行不行。
en: Strategy Lab does one thing: you bring an idea, and it tells you whether the idea actually works.

zh: 具体说：先选一个世界（数据从哪里来，比如一条随机涨跌的价格），再定一条规则（每一步怎么做，比如涨了就买）。页面把这条规则放到成千上万条路径上各跑一遍，把结果摆出来：平均赚多少，最坏亏多少，和什么也不做相比差多少，这个差别是不是运气。
en: Concretely: first choose a world (where the data comes from, for example a price that moves up and down at random), then set a rule (what to do at each step, for example buy after a rise). The page runs this rule on thousands of paths and lays out the results: how much it earns on average, how much it loses at worst, how it compares with doing nothing, and whether that difference is just luck.

zh: 大厅里的几样东西，是把同一件事变成和别人一起玩：同一局大家比一比，规则和规则当对手，自己造世界让别人来试。
en: The things in the lobby turn the same activity into something you do with other people: everyone compares on the same episode, rules play against rules, and you build worlds for others to try.

zh: 这份教程每步两三分钟，不用按顺序。每一步有一个按钮带你去那个地方；做完之后，点左下角的"回到教程"接着看。
en: Each step of this tutorial takes two or three minutes, and you need not follow the order. Every step has a button that takes you there; when you are done, click "Back to the tutorial" at the bottom left to continue.

zh: 打一局
en: Play an episode

zh: 先亲手打一局
en: Play an episode yourself first

zh: 这一步不用写任何东西。全站每天同一局，玩法轮着来（§0§），一局只有几十个回合，两三分钟打完。
en: This step needs no writing at all. Everyone on the site gets the same episode each day, and the games take turns (§0§); an episode has only a few dozen rounds and takes two or three minutes.

zh: 打完之后看两样东西。第一，你的得分和几条参照规则在同一局上的得分：你是真的打得好，还是只是这一局运气好？第二，今天的榜：你排在所有人的哪个位置。
en: When you finish, look at two things. First, your score next to the scores of a few reference rules on the same episode: did you really play well, or was this episode just lucky? Second, today's board: where you rank among everyone.

zh: 想上榜，点"把我的成绩贴到榜上"（需要 GitHub 账号，最后一步有说明）。不贴也没关系，成绩已经存在这台设备上了。
en: To get on the board, click "Post my result to the board" (this needs a GitHub account; the last step explains). If you do not post, that is fine too: your result is already saved on this device.

zh: 打今天这一局
en: Play today's episode

zh: 开房间
en: Open a room

zh: 拉朋友开一个房间
en: Open a room with friends

zh: 最多八个人同时打同一局。开房间的人挑玩法，把邀请链接发给朋友；人到齐了点"开始"。
en: Up to eight people play the same episode at the same time. Whoever opens the room picks the game and sends the invite link to friends; when everyone is in, click "Start".

zh: 打的时候只看得到别人打到第几回合，看不到别人怎么选。所有人都打完，成绩一起揭晓，再和参照规则在同一局上比。
en: While playing you can only see which round the others have reached, not what they choose. Once everyone has finished, the results are revealed together and then compared with the reference rules on the same episode.

zh: 不需要账号，起个名字就能进。一个人也能开房间，先看看它是什么样子。
en: No account is needed; pick a name and you are in. You can also open a room alone, just to see what it is like.

zh: 开一个房间
en: Open a room

zh: 写规则
en: Write a rule

zh: 写你的第一条规则
en: Write your first rule

zh: 规则是一小段代码：每一步拿到眼下看得到的东西，交出一个数（比如仓位、出价）。它只看得到过去，看不到未来。
en: A rule is a small piece of code: at each step it receives what can be seen at that moment and hands back a number (a position, say, or a bid). It sees only the past, never the future.

zh: 不会写代码也可以，有三条路：
en: You do not have to know how to code; there are three ways:

zh: 改现成的。找到"规则"那一块（手机上先点"玩法与规则"），点它下面的"代码与说明"，换到"代码"那一页，把里面的一两个数改掉，点"应用修改"：它就另存成了你自己的一条。
en: Change an existing one. Find the "Rule" block (on a phone, tap "Game & rule" first), click "Code & notes" below it, switch to the "Code" page, change a number or two, and click "Apply changes": it is saved as a rule of your own.

zh: 让页面里的 AI 写。打开 §0§ 面板（电脑上是右上角的按钮，手机上是同名的那一页），用一句话说出想法；它会写出规则、给出参数，并解释为什么这样写。这条路要用你自己的 API 密钥。
en: Let the AI in the page write it. Open the §0§ panel (the button at the top right on a computer; the tab of the same name on a phone) and state your idea in one sentence; it writes the rule, gives the parameters and explains why it is written that way. This way needs your own API key.

zh: 让你平常用的 AI 写。规则同场和世界工坊里，写规则的地方都有一个"复制给 AI 的说明"：点一下，贴给任何一个 AI，再把它回的代码贴回来。
en: Let the AI you normally use write it. In the rule arena and the world workshop, wherever a rule is written there is a "Copy a brief for an AI" button: click it, paste the text to any AI, and paste the code it replies with back in.

zh: 看看眼下这条规则的代码
en: See the code of the current rule

zh: 十项全能
en: Decathlon

zh: 它是不是只在一种行情里好使
en: Does it only work in one kind of market?

zh: 一条规则在一个世界里表现好，说明不了什么：也许它只是碰巧合了那个世界的脾气。十项全能让一条规则走遍十个世界，每个世界里都和"买入持有"（买了就不动）比长期增长率。十个差里最小的那一个，就是它的得分。
en: A rule doing well in one world says little: perhaps it just happens to suit that world. The decathlon sends one rule through ten worlds and, in each, compares its long-run growth rate with "buy and hold" (buy once and never move). The smallest of the ten differences is its score.

zh: 所以得分高于 0 很不容易：它得在十种行情里都不比什么也不做差。
en: So a score above 0 is hard to get: the rule must be no worse than doing nothing in ten kinds of market.

zh: 每个星期一换一批路径。自己的规则可以贴到榜上；榜上的分数不是贴的人报的，而是每个看榜的人在自己的浏览器里重新算出来的。
en: The paths change every Monday. You can post your own rule to the board; the scores on the board are not reported by the people who posted, but recomputed by every viewer in their own browser.

zh: 走一遍十项
en: Run the ten events

zh: 规则同场
en: Rule arena

zh: 有对手的时候
en: When there are opponents

zh: 前面的规则都是各打各的。规则同场把几条规则放进同一个市场互相当对手：一起竞价（出价最高的买走），或者一起做市（报价最好的成交）。你赚多少，取决于别人怎么出手。
en: The rules so far each played on their own. The rule arena puts several rules into the same market as each other's opponents: bidding against each other (the highest bid buys), or making a market together (the best quote trades). How much you earn depends on what the others do.

zh: 先点"开始比"，看自带的几条规则谁赢，谁中了"赢家诅咒"。再点"写一条新的"，改一改让价的大小，看能不能挤进前两名。
en: First click "Run the matches" and see which of the built-in rules wins and which falls for the "winner's curse". Then click "Write a new one", change how much it shades its bid, and see whether it can make the top two.

zh: 摆一场
en: Set up a match

zh: 世界工坊
en: World workshop

zh: 连世界和裁判一起造
en: Build the world and the referee too

zh: 世界是一段生成价格的代码；玩法是一个发牌、判分的裁判。这两样也可以自己写。
en: A world is code that generates prices; a game is a referee that deals and scores. You can write these two as well.

zh: 先看样板：打开"涨跌停板"，点"试一试"，看它生成的价格长什么样；再点"拿到实验室里用"，换几条规则，看谁在这个世界里好使。
en: Start with a template: open "Daily price limits" and click "Try it" to see what the prices it generates look like; then click "Use in the lab" and switch between a few rules to see which works in this world.

zh: 然后换到"玩法"那一边，打开"掷骰子，见好就收"，点"比一比"；再自己写一条规则，看能不能赢过"攒到 20 分就收"。（提示：平均下来赢不了，它是最优的；能做到的只是打平。）
en: Then switch to the "Games" side, open "Roll the die, quit while ahead" and click "Compare"; then write a rule of your own and see whether it can beat "Stop at 20 points". (Hint: on average it cannot, because that rule is optimal; the best you can do is tie.)

zh: 进工坊
en: Enter the workshop

zh: 贴给别人
en: Share

zh: 把你做的东西贴给别人
en: Post what you made for others

zh: 这张页面没有自己的服务器。大家的榜、别人写的规则、世界和玩法，都是 GitHub 上公开的帖子（GitHub 管它叫 Issue）。
en: This page has no server of its own. Everyone's boards and the rules, worlds and games written by others are all public posts on GitHub (GitHub calls them issues).

zh: 贴东西：在要贴的地方点"贴到 GitHub"或者"把我的成绩贴到榜上"。页面会把内容填好、打开 GitHub，你在那里点 Submit new issue。这需要一个 GitHub 账号；帖子是公开的，署你的用户名；想撤回，把那条帖子关掉就行。
en: To post: click "Post to GitHub" or "Post my result to the board" wherever you want to post. The page fills in the content and opens GitHub, where you click Submit new issue. This needs a GitHub account; the post is public and carries your username; to take it back, just close that issue.

zh: 用别人的东西：别人写的代码一律在隔离环境里运行，碰不到这张页面里的东西，也连不了网。觉得哪一份好，去它的帖子上点 👍，赞多的排在前面。
en: To use other people's work: code written by other people always runs in an isolated environment; it cannot touch anything on this page and cannot reach the network. If you like something, give its post a 👍; the ones with more likes are listed first.

zh: 只是看榜不需要账号。GitHub 对不登录的访问有次数限制（每小时 60 次），偶尔会让你过一会儿再刷新。
en: Just viewing the boards needs no account. GitHub limits requests made without signing in (60 per hour), so now and then you will be asked to refresh a little later.

zh: 回到大厅
en: Back to the lobby

zh: 回到教程（第 §0§ 步）
en: Back to the tutorial (step §0§)

zh: 不用了
en: No thanks

zh: 教程的各步
en: Steps of the tutorial

zh: 上一步
en: Back

zh: 下一步
en: Next

zh: 新手教程
en: Beginner's tutorial

zh: 去过了
en: Visited

zh: 这一步去过了
en: You have been here
Step §0§ of §1§

zh: 看完了
en: Done

zh: 第一次来
en: First time here

zh: 接着看
en: Continue

zh: 开始
en: Start

zh: tutorial 教程 新手 入门 上手 怎么玩 第一次 start guide
en: tutorial beginner getting started intro how to play first time start guide walkthrough

zh: 八步，每步两三分钟：亲手打一局，开一个房间，写第一条规则，让它走十项全能、和别的规则同场，再到工坊里造一个世界。每一步都有一个按钮带你过去。
en: Eight steps of two or three minutes each: play an episode yourself, open a room, write your first rule, send it through the decathlon and into the arena against other rules, then build a world in the workshop. Every step has a button that takes you there.

zh: 上次看到第 §0§ 步，共 §1§ 步
en: Last time you reached step §0§ of §1§
